'''Rel Acoi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who led the [[Oquan]], a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naalol/Legends|Naalol]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] procurement [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Talnar]] crash-landed on Naalol, the Oquan captured Talnar and Acoi subsequently met with a group of Alliance agents in [[Rigoton Spaceport]], to attempt to persuade the Rebels to pay a ransom for Talnar's release.<ref name="Talnar" />
